source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseCursorSyncTest { @isTest static void cursorAndSyncSurfacesRunLocally() { insert new Account(Name = 'Acme', Rating = 'Hot'); insert new Account(Name = 'Beta', Rating = 'Warm'); Database.Cursor cursor = Database.getCursor('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name'); System.assertEquals(2, cursor.getNumRecords()); System.assertEquals(1, cursor.fetch(0, 1).size()); Database.Cursor modeCursor = Database.getCursor('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name', AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, modeCursor.getNumRecords()); Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>(); binds.put('rating', 'Warm'); Database.Cursor boundCursor = Database.getCursorWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Rating = :rating ORDER BY Name', binds, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, boundCursor.getNumRecords()); List<SObject> boundRows = boundCursor.fetch(0, 1); System.assertEquals(1, boundRows.size()); System.assertEquals('Beta', boundRows.get(0).get('Name')); Database.PaginationCursor page = Database.getPaginationCursor('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name'); System.assertEquals(2, page.getNumRecords()); Database.CursorFetchResult pageResult = page.fetchPage(0, 2); System.assertEquals(2, pageResult.getRecords().size()); System.assertEquals(0, pageResult.getNextIndex()); System.assertEquals(0, pageResult.getNumDeletedRecords()); System.assert(pageResult.isDone()); System.assertEquals(0, page.fetchDeleted(0, 1)); Database.PaginationCursor modePage = Database.getPaginationCursor('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name', AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, modePage.fetchPage(0, 2).getRecords().size()); Database.PaginationCursor boundPage = Database.getPaginationCursorWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Rating = :rating ORDER BY Name', binds, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); Database.CursorFetchResult boundPageResult = boundPage.fetchPage(0, 1); System.assertEquals(1, boundPageResult.getRecords().size()); Datetime start = Datetime.now().addDays(-1); Datetime finish = start.addHours(1); Database.GetDeletedResult deleted = Database.getDeleted('Account', start, finish); System.assertEquals(0, deleted.getDeletedRecords().size()); System.assertEquals(null, deleted.getEarliestDateAvailable()); System.assertNotEquals(null, deleted.getLatestDateCovered()); Database.GetUpdatedResult updated = Database.getUpdated('Account', start, finish); System.assertEquals(0, updated.getIds().size()); System.assertNotEquals(null, updated.getLatestDateCovered()); } }
